description:
ws/mod.rs:67-88 defines WsFrame::Unknown { type_name, raw: serde_json::Value }. The doc-comment at lines 75-86 explicitly warns 'DO NOT log this field verbatim. Future or extension JMAP WebSocket message types may carry credential-grade material — push verification codes (RFC 8887 §7.2), federation handshake tokens, session-rotation challenges, etc. — and a malformed Response to a method like PushSubscription/get can echo a verificationCode back into this field. The enum derives Debug, so a {:?}-format of any WsFrame::Unknown writes this Value to the output stream.'

But the enum still derives Debug (line 53: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]), and there is no manual redacting impl. A contributor doing the natural Rust thing — derive Debug, use {:?} for diagnostics — leaks credential-grade data per the WARNING IN THE CRATE'S OWN DOC.

This is the workspace's 'Security testing' pattern #1 territory (per-type Debug redaction canary, per the workspace AGENTS.md): the type carries a credential under some failure mode, so Debug must redact OR the type must not derive Debug.

Options:
1. Manual redacting Debug on WsFrame::Unknown that prints  for the raw field. Keeps {:?} useful for debugging while eliminating the leak class.
2. Remove the raw field entirely; require callers who want it to call a separate fallible accessor that surfaces the credential warning at the type level.
3. Wrap raw in a newtype with redacting Debug.

The doc-only guard is fragile: a future contributor adding tracing instrumentation will write tracing::warn!('unknown ws frame: {frame:?}') and leak the field, exactly the kind of #1 pattern that JMAP-sc1b.79/.98 set up regression tests for in other types but NOT for this one.
title: WsFrame::Unknown.raw derives Debug despite credential-leak warning in doc — no manual redacting Debug
